notes.title: JUJU launches today!
notes.notes:
JUJU has been released into the wild - or onto Steam, Xbox 360, and PS3 to be exact - and  we here at Flying Wild Hog have a new trailer to share with you. 

Check out the undersea shenanigans of the launch trailer!:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p7DFHy7jgUE

JUJU is bright and cheery, but don't mistake it for a kiddie game. JUJU was created because the developers' wanted a co-op game that they could enjoy playing while allowing their kids to join in.

With JUJU's co-op mechanics, older gamers can crank up the difficulty all the way to Nightmare, while kids getting their feet wet in gaming can still play along as Peyo; an optional character with abilities that make him easier to use. And, features like infinite respawns, shared health-boosts, and lack of scores keep JUJU a true co-op experience free of competition.

http://www.jujuandpeyo.com
